clean_accuracy_floor_reason: Null on the same convention as the ramp: the clean-accuracy tolerance is a band around the reference model's measured clean accuracy on the grading host, so authoring it at Phase 0 would invent the measurement it is a tolerance around. tests/test_output.py's clean_accuracy_tolerance check calls require_measured on it and raises rather than scoring.
graded_binning_basis: Authored, not measured: an equal-width partition of [0,1] fixed before any graded run, so CK-BINFAM's alternate-binning family has a pinned reference to compare against and CTL-GRADEDBINS has a concrete object to be rejected for fitting to.
measured_values_reason: Null by seed/contract.yaml's own convention: every quantity recorded null is measured at Phase 1 build time on the grading host and never authored at Phase 0. Authoring a floor, knee or ablation worth here would invent a measurement the bytes have not earned.
